Hi Sarah —

Thanks — excited to set this up. Quick note: our Solutions Engineering lead (Dev) and I will be traveling early next week, and Alex will be partially OOO for client visits. We'd like to request a small shift to allow our team time to prep (review your prompt sets + workload traces, provision temporary access for sample data).

Would Tue Mar 10 or Wed Mar 11 work for you? If so, we can block 45 minutes and have a short 15-minute internal prep the day before.

Prep checklist (attached): redwood_demo-checklist.pdf — highlights we typically need:
- prompt set(s) in .txt or .csv
- sample data/workload trace (small subset)
- a list of success criteria for the demo (latency target, cost constraints)
- any access we should provision (S3 bucket, sandbox API keys)

If you can share the sample_data_v2.csv and prompt_set_v1.txt by EOD Mar 3, Dev will run a quick validation and confirm there are no blockers.

Appreciate it — looping in Alex and Dev to confirm availability.

Best,
Marissa Cole
